news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 1.2% Last year net profit margin: 2.1% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Market cap is less than US$10m (₹346.8m market cap, or US$3.83m). Minor Risk Profit margins are more than 30% lower than last year (1.2% net profit margin).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.75 (vs ₹0.95 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.75 (down from ₹0.95 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹716.9m (up 12% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹11.1m (down 21% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.5% (down from 2.2% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 1% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 5% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
